subject: Admin activity ledger: datasets, retention windows, and extract playbook
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novomed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rios <alex.rios@novomed.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity ledger - data items and export options for SOC 2 SIG/CAIQ

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for taking time this morning. As part of our SOC 2 evidence collection we need a concise inventory of the admin activity records you can provide for our account. Specifically we need: 1) a short list of the event types you log (privileged logins, role changes, API key rotations, RBAC policy edits, console sessions, delegation events, etc.), 2) the retention windows for each event class, and 3) what export formats you can deliver (CSV, Parquet, signed manifests). We also want to understand query SLA (how long a scoped extract takes for a 30-day window) and any sampling/aggregation you apply.

Can you send an example manifest and a step-by-step for extracting a signed dataset we can hand to our auditors? We have a deadline for the SOC 2 pack on 2026-07-02.

Cheers,
Claire
Claire Huang
Principal Security Analyst
Novomed Health

Attachments: none
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novomed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin activity ledger - data items and export options for SOC 2 SIG/CAIQ

Claire — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise inventory and an export playbook attached. I copied Karthik (platform) and Neha (compliance) to confirm SLAs and redaction options.

Quick inventory (high level):
- Event classes (examples): privilege_escalation, role_assignment, api_key_rotated, api_key_deleted, console_signin_success, console_signin_failed, session_terminated, permission_change, dataset_access, model_deploy, model_rollback, service_principal_change.
- Logged fields: event_id, timestamp (UTC, ms), actor_internal (user_id), actor_external (ip/email when applicable), target_resource (id/type), org_unit, action, outcome (success/failure), request_payload_sha256 (when applicable), kv_cache_delta (for operator actions), request_id, correlation_id, request_headers_meta.
- Retention windows: standard: 365 days for admin events; privileged actions and auth failures: 2 years (configurable under enterprise contracts); short-lived ephemeral debug traces: 30 days unless requested for a forensic snapshot.
- Export formats supported: CSV (field-delimited), Parquet (columnar), gzipped JSONL, and a signed-tar with SHA256 manifest + GPG signature for attestation.
- Sampling & aggregation: exports are full by default. For very large tenants we offer timebox sampling or tokenized deltas; any sampling must be agreed during the handshake and will be reflected in the signed manifest.

Attached: export_playbook_v2.pdf (step-by-step, checksums, redaction options) and admin_activity_manifest_v1.csv (example manifest column names). Query SLA & throughput:
- On-demand scoped extract (30d window, typical production tenant): 2–6 hours depending on period and retention tier.
- Reserved export (reserved capacity / Dedicated customers): 30–90 minutes SLA for a 30d extract.

Deliverables we can provide to auditors: full signed dataset, signed manifest with file-level checksums, short attestation letter from Redwood security, and a query trace showing the export job ID and timestamps.

Next steps: if you want a signed snapshot by 2026-06-29 we can schedule a one-off export; otherwise we can provide the manifest and sample files to review.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference

Tessa,

Thanks — that helps a lot. Couple of clarifying Qs from our auditor: 1) For the signed-tar option, do you include a manifest of redaction operations (so we can see which fields were redacted and why)? 2) Can you confirm whether exports include the original request payloads for model inference API calls by default, or if those are omitted/hashed? 3) Do you support timezone-normalized timestamps in the manifest or only UTC?

We'd like the 30-day snapshot for 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30 if you can fit it before 06/29. If not, we'll accept a manifest and sample outputs.

Alex
IT Compliance Lead
Novomed Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rios <alex.rios@novomed.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@novomed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin activity ledger - data items and export options for SOC 2 SIG/CAIQ

Alex — answers inline and an action list below. Happy to hop on a short call if you prefer.

1) Redaction manifest: yes — for any export that applies redaction we include a redaction_manifest.csv that lists file_name, field_path, redaction_reason (PII, customer_request, legal_hold), redaction_method (mask/hash/remove), and a signed hash of the original file if we retain one. This is part of the signed-tar deliverable.

2) Request payloads: by default, raw inference request payloads are not included in admin activity exports. We retain payload metadata (payload_sha256, token_count, model_version) to protect customer data by default. Full request payloads can be included only under a strict legal/contractual request and are delivered to enterprise/private deployments with additional controls.

3) Timestamps: core export manifests use UTC ISO8601 with millisecond precision. We include a column timezone_hint when requested to assist mapping to local audit systems.

Action items:
- We can run the 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-30 snapshot as a signed-tar; earliest completion without reserved capacity: 2026-06-29 22:00 UTC. Can you confirm acceptance of the default redaction rules (PII hashed, IPs truncated to /24) or supply specific redaction instructions?
- If you need full request payloads we require a Data Processing Addendum amendment and a scoped review (legal/compliance).
- I'll attach the export job id and manifest when the run completes.

Cc'ing Karthik and Neha to schedule the job and confirm SLA.

Regards,
Tessa
